proof_obligations.finite_abbreviation: Every domain above is obtained by finite enum, finite range, finite sum, finite product, or a fixed-length vector over a finite alphabet.  The nested generation loops therefore print a finite ordinary PEG.
proof_obligations.lmr_refinement: The full families are precisely State(q), Label(gamma), Neighbourhood(N), Path(p), Transition(q,sigma,N), and AutomatonAccepts from the sufficient direction of Theorem 16.
proof_obligations.macro_locality: In at most B unit moves a head starting inside a B-cell aligned block cannot leave that block and its two neighbours.
proof_obligations.one_new_node: If the final head lies in a neighbouring block, the opposite neighbour was not visited; the persistent stack update uses paths of length at most two.
proof_obligations.total_delta: Canonical reachable neighbourhoods use exact bounded-delay simulation.  Every other member of the finite LMR neighbourhood domain is sent to a fixed rejecting sink state and sink label, so delta is total.
proof_obligations.unique_initial_state: A synthetic INITIAL state is used only on the unlabelled base and is never re-entered, matching the normalization used in the LMR proof.
